---
title: SpectralMDL
---

SpectralMDL is a spectral, LLVM-based JIT compiler for the
[Material Definition Language](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/design-visualization/technologies/material-definition-language),
intended as a middleware C++ library in offline physically-based rendering
programs.

See the [API reference](doxygen/html/index.html).
